reconstruction: Replace original Cross and Passive with a single two-leg US100/US500 relative-value book. Four original US30 engines remain unchanged. No original Cross parent or Passive pending opportunity survives inside these two candidate slots. Both legs have a new joint identity, admission, entry-frozen target and paired exit.

sources.copy: Physical own timestamp-only M1 slice2023-12-01 through2026-01-01exclusive and original2024/2025 Cross+Passive BIRTH/CLOSE rows. No candidate2026price fields,closedcandidate source/model/state/parameter or Live/Lab execution.

clock.observation: At M15 grid D, require all15 M1 timestamps in[D-900,D) for each symbol, finite positive prices and nonnegative spread. S_D=log(last US100 bid close/last US500 bid close). Last completed M1 spread for each leg is known atD. Missing prefix remains an explicit zero-opportunity calendar row, not synthetic fill.
clock.training_label: A complete consecutive next M15 observation S_(D+900) is available only atD+900. Model parameter updates consume it only when D+900<new forecast grid. Missing future observation does not erase the earlier forecast.
clock.calendar: Every M15 slot in2025 and every365calendar date remain visible. Native source/server numeric epochs stay unshifted; no intended external session or new external economic data.
clock.benchmark: Original Cross+Passive2025 actual35.38/stress30.319,325 lifecycles; H1 27.52/25.1275,149;H2 7.86/5.1915,176. These are descriptive source hurdles, not a fixed-quantity counterfactual.

fit.period: All complete2024 current/next M15 pairs whose next-label availability is strictly before2025-01-01.
fit.normalization: Train-only mean and populationSD of current S_D, floor1e-6. z=(S-mean)/SD; no clipping or future normalization.
fit.error_correction: Fit z_next=c+phi*z_current using X=[1,z], one ridge solution A=X.TX+diag(1,10); right-hand side=X.Ty+[0,10] (prior c0,phi1). Initial P=inverse(A). No feature, horizon, model, regularization or seed search.
fit.stationarity: Model is tradable only for0<phi<1. An estimated non-mean-reverting law is an economic abstention state, not silently clipped or re-fitted. Nonfinite arithmetic is an engineering correction.
fit.onnx: Fresh float32 graph with inputs z[1,1],drift[1,1],persistence[1,1]; exactly8 repeated Mul/Add recurrences computes future_z[1,1]. Learned parameters and online state are own files, no old beta/model imported. IR8/opset17.
fit.forecast: Model input z and c/phi are float32 casts; prediction=(ONNX eight-step future_z - float32current_z)*frozen SD. Entry equilibrium is frozen_mean+frozenSD*c_float32/(1-phi_float32). Model estimates joint relative-price error correction, not the old common-market return beta.

online.initial: Same2024 c/phi/P/normalization as STATIC. Empty pending2025queue; no excluded2024late label is adopted.
online.update: At every new M15 grid consume complete pending labels with label_end<grid, oldest first. lambda=.999; k=P*x/(lambda+x.T*P*x); theta=theta+k*(y-x.Ttheta); P=(P-k*(x.TP))/lambda, then symmetrize. No reset, clipping, adaptive forgetting or outcome tuning. Finite positive denominator/diagonal covariance are required normal numerical preconditions.
online.market_data_only: Every market observation drives learning irrespective of book occupancy or trade outcomes. Store original x and one-step prediction; only future observed z becomes the later label. Record next-step error versus random-walk z reference and exact update bounds.
online.open_book: Subsequent parameter changes never alter a live book target, direction, quantity, original stop or deadline.

book.entry: Evaluate each M15 D with server08:00<=D<20:00 and no existing/closing own book. Require0<phi_float32<1 and abs(eight-step forecast)>2*(max(.01,completed US100 spread)/US100reference close+max(.01,completed US500 spread)/US500reference close). Long US100/short US500 for positive forecast, reverse for negative. At native entry repeat hurdle with max(completed,fresh executable spread) per leg.
book.quantity: US100 anchor uses original market daily-lot staircase times base0.01. US500 volume is nearest legal0.01 step to US100volume*US100entryquote/US500entryquote, with minimum0.01; no return-beta estimate or adjustable hedge fraction. Both contract sizes must equal the anchored unit USD contract. Nearest rounding is floor(units+0.5), with no outcome-dependent rounding choice.
book.admission: Four preserved original US30 engine schedules/directions/quantities/order remain unchanged. Assess the new book after their ordinary entry processing. Reserve two full original4%conservative-capital planned-risk budgets before sending either leg, within original12%aggregate/45%margin caps. No offsetting/net risk credit and no old signal deleted to create room beyond the declared two-engine replacement.
book.execution: Normal synchronous protected market requests within[D,D+120), with separate new leg Magic and one joint book id. Both legs need original fresh quote/session/protection eligibility. Durable paired intent and reserved risk precede leg1. Leg2failure requires completion/closing of partial book before any new action; unresolved implementation faults are correction states, not a trade result or new hedge policy.
book.stops: Each native leg uses original CalculateProtectiveStop: budget4%conservative capital, gross half-budget, original tick/min-stop buffers and full risk reservation. Never net the two risks. On any leg stop/completion, close surviving leg at first legal fresh opportunity before admitting another book. No orphan re-entry.
book.normal_exit: At each M15 observation, close both if spread crosses the entry-frozen equilibrium in the entry direction, or at D_entry+8*900, whichever first. Deadline is two hours, sessionentry before20:00; no hold extension, target adaptation, trailing or profitSL. Paired closing duties also run after broker transactions.
book.scope: This is a low-turnover relative-value portfolio book, not a claim of high-turnover entry supply. Minimum paired activity is fixed in selection/native gates; no later density-driven window/hurdle broadening.

selection.period: 2025only, both halves, all calendar/observed dates. Both roles share original M1 source and ordinary fixed-volume quote path.
selection.benchmark_gate: Stressed paired quote net strictly greater than original Cross+Passive actual35.38USD; each half stressed positive; at least50 complete paired starts and at least10 in each half. Both complete legs and all opportunity/learning rows must be retained; no model/input fault.
selection.quantity_risk: Fixed US1000.01,US500 nearest notional quantity at entry, unit contracts. Each leg has fixed100USD*4%budget and half-budget gross SL2USD, tick-aligned toward entry so gross risk does not exceed2. No account compounding/admission/margin/financing authority is inferred.
selection.entry_approximation: First minute at/afterD with both original M1 opens, within[D,D+120); otherwise explicit unfilled intent. Quote sides use M1 representative spread only as execution cost, never a future feature/hurdle. Genuine missing ticks/minutes remain absent, no interpolation or favorable selection.
selection.path: Process the union of both symbols observed M1 rows chronologically. For each leg, opening-gap SL precedes requested/time close, then adverse minute extreme can trigger SL. Long stop=min(bidopen,SL),short=max(askopen,SL). If a leg stops within a minute, surviving leg is requested closed strictly after that minute and fills at its first subsequent observed M1 open; never retroactively at the stopped minute open. Time/mean-cross request at gridD closes each leg at its first observed open at/afterD; completed-bar spread alone can trigger the target. New book requires both prior legs closed. For every stop detected in minute t, including an opening-gap stop, newly requested survivor closure is no earlier than t+60. An independently existing earlier time/target close request remains eligible. Both legs may pessimistically hit their stops inside the same M1 bar. An occupied book at grid D records OCCUPIED_AT_DECISION and does not retain that signal for admission after the old book closes.
selection.accounting: Pair actual proxy is sum of executable-side leg quote PNL. Stress subtracts per-leg max(entry,exit representative spread)*actuallegvolume plus adverse stop gap*volume. No positive financing credit or invented commission. Both futures/opportunities remain retained even when a book cannot fill; exact native tick synchronization, fees/financing, shared risk/capital, partial execution and full equity remain conditional.
selection.report: Every forecast with stationarity/missing-prefix/hurdle state, every mature/pending label and one-step forecast score, complete two-leg trade/close/cost tapes, all daily/half-year quotePNL and fixed-cashDD. A negative cash series is fixed-volume quote evidence, not a feasible account beyond ruin.
selection.ranking: Highest stressed quote net among qualifiers,STATICon exact tie. At most one survivor. No alternate after confirmation and no adjacent pair,ratio,clock,ARprior,forgetting,threshold,session,hold,target,risk,volume or component rescue.
